jobs.done_when: The customer is verified and logged, or told they could not be verified. Their referral history (9-day window and per-type annual counts) and account tenure have been checked from the records. Then one of two outcomes holds. (a) The customer was told the referral cannot be submitted now and why: rolling window full, tenure too short, same registered address, referred party not new or same business owner, signer under 18, or no program's deposit, cap or age rule met. No recommendation was given and nothing was submitted. (b) The customer was told the eligible account to use (personal: highest combined bonus; business: highest referrer bonus), with both bonus amounts, the qualifying deposit and its window, and the conditions. They have submitted submit_referral with that account type ending in 'Account' (or know to do so), and the result has been explained.

when.quote: Each checking account type has its own referral bonus amounts and qualification requirements. This document covers the general terms and restrictions that apply to all checking account referral programs.

starts.note: Customer only: the customer asks to refer someone, or asks which account to use for a referral. The agent never submits the referral. The customer runs submit_referral themselves. Eligibility must be checked before giving any recommendation or referral terms.
starts.quote: Before giving any recommendations or information on referral terms, you must check that the user is eligible to submit referrals first

tools.not_used: Not part of this job. Use it only under the general policy: the issue cannot be resolved and the customer agrees to a transfer, or the customer asks for a human 4 times. An ineligible referral is not a transfer case. Explain the reason and stop.

info.about: Any 2 of date of birth, email, phone number, address, plus a name, email or user id to look up the customer's record
info.ask: To verify your identity, could you give me your full name and two of the following: date of birth, email, phone number, or address?

info.about: Whether the referred person is registered at the same address as the customer
info.ask: Is the person you're referring registered at the same address as you?

info.about: Whether the referred person or business has had any Rho-Bank checking, savings or closed account in the past 12 months
info.ask: Has the person or business you're referring had any Rho-Bank checking or savings account, open or closed, in the past 12 months?

info.about: For business referrals: whether the primary authorized signer of the referred business is a different person (by SSN) from the primary owner of any existing Rho-Bank business account, including the customer
info.ask: Is the primary owner/authorized signer of the new business a different person from the owner of any existing Rho-Bank business account, including yours?

info.about: How much new money (not transferred from a Rho-Bank account) the referred business plans to deposit, and roughly when
info.ask: About how much will the new business deposit when it opens the account, and will that money come from outside Rho-Bank?

info.about: How long ago the referred business was formed. This only matters when Sky Blue is a candidate, because Sky Blue is for companies within 4 years of formation.
info.ask: When was the business you're referring formed?

info.about: date_opened of the customer's earliest Rho-Bank checking account
The customer's past referrals, with account types, dates and statuses

steps.do: Ask for the customer's name, email or user id and look up their record with the matching get_user_information_by_* tool.

args.customer_name: the name the customer gives (or email → get_user_information_by_email, user id → get_user_information_by_id)

steps.quote: Verify the customer's identity and account ownership

steps.do: Ask for any 2 of date of birth, email, phone number, address and compare them with the record. If fewer than 2 match, do not share or look up anything else. Ask again, and stop if the customer cannot verify.
steps.quote: Verify the customer's identity and account ownership

steps.do: Get the current time. It is used for the verification log, tenure, the 9-day window and the calendar-year counts.
steps.if: verification succeeded
steps.quote: A rolling 9-day window means the count is evaluated based on the exact timestamps of your most recent referral bonuses, not calendar weeks.

steps.do: Log the verification record.
steps.if: verification succeeded
steps.quote: Verify the customer's identity and account ownership

steps.do: Unlock the bank-account lookup tool.
steps.if: verification succeeded
steps.quote: Use get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 to retrieve the bank accounts (checkings, savings) for a customer.

steps.do: Read all of the customer's bank accounts, with account_type, account_class, status and date_opened.
steps.if: verification succeeded
steps.quote: Checking eligibility requirements for opening new accounts (existing account status, balances, account tenure, number of accounts)

steps.do: Read every referral the customer has made: account type, date and status.
steps.if: verification succeeded
steps.quote: Track the timing of your last two successful referral bonuses before sending additional referrals.

steps.do: Count the customer's referrals dated within the 9 days before the current time, across all account types. Use the records, not the customer's recollection. If 2 or more, a new referral would be auto-denied. Tell the customer they cannot submit a referral now and must wait until the oldest of those referrals is more than 9 days old. Give no recommendation and stop.
steps.quote: If you attempt to receive more than 2 referrals in a single 9-day period, the third referral (and any subsequent referrals in that window) will be automatically denied.

steps.do: Find the earliest date_opened among the customer's checking accounts and compute the days until the current time. Any checking account counts, whatever its type. Keep this tenure for the per-program check. If the customer has no checking account, or tenure is under 45 days (the lowest program minimum), tell them they are not yet eligible to refer and stop.
steps.quote: This threshold is calculated from when you first became a Rho-Bank checking customer—specifically, the date your earliest checking account was opened.

steps.do: Ask for any facts about the referred person or business not yet given: same address as the customer? Any Rho-Bank checking, savings or closed account in the past 12 months? Primary owner different from any existing Rho-Bank business account? Expected deposit amount, and is it new money? When was the business formed (only if Sky Blue could be a candidate)?
steps.if: the rolling-window and tenure checks passed
steps.quote: The referrer and referred person cannot be registered at the same address.

steps.do: If the referred person shares the customer's address, or had a Rho-Bank account in the past 12 months, or (for a business) has the same primary owner as an existing Rho-Bank business account, tell the customer the referral would be denied, explain why, and stop without recommending.
steps.quote: For business accounts: The referred business must have a different primary owner than any existing Rho-Bank business account, based on the SSN of the primary authorized signer.

steps.do: For each business checking program, keep it only if all of these hold: (a) tenure ≥ the program's minimum; (b) the customer's referrals of that account type in the current calendar year (from get_referrals) are below its annual cap; (c) the expected new-money deposit ≥ its qualifying deposit; (d) for Sky Blue, the business is within 4 years of formation. Programs (referrer bonus / cap / deposit within window / tenure): Beige $500/15/$100,000 in 120 days/120 days; True Blue $350/15/$50,000 in 120 days/90 days; World Blue $300/12/$25,000 in 90 days/90 days; Lime Green $200/12/$15,000 in 90 days/90 days; Hunter Green $175/10/$10,000 in 90 days/60 days; Cobalt Blue $150/10/$7,500 in 90 days/60 days; Sky Blue $150/8/$10,000 in 90 days/45 days; Navy Blue $100/10/$5,000 in 90 days/60 days. Pick the remaining program with the highest referrer bonus. If none remains, tell the customer no business checking referral can qualify now, and why, then stop.
steps.quote: Consequently, holding one account type does not prevent you from referring someone to a different account type, as long as the duration since your first account meets or exceeds the program's stated minimum.

steps.do: Recommend the chosen account. State the referrer bonus and the referred business's welcome bonus, the qualifying deposit and its window, and the conditions: the deposit must be new money and stay at least 30 days after the qualifying period; the bonus may be clawed back if the account closes within 90 days; it cannot be combined with other promotions. If the choice is Beige, also say that Beige referrals go through the customer's dedicated relationship manager.
steps.if: an eligible program remains
steps.quote: The qualifying deposit must remain in the account for at least 30 days after the qualifying period ends.

steps.do: If the customer wants to go ahead, they run submit_referral themselves with their own user id and the recommended account type, named '<Name> Account' (for example 'World Blue Account'). The agent does not submit it.
steps.if: the customer chooses to submit the recommended referral
steps.quote: Someone with a Navy Blue account can refer others for World Blue, True Blue, or any other checking product—provided they've met the duration requirement.

steps.do: If the customer reports an ERROR result, tell them to try again later. If REJECTED, explain the likely reason from the eligibility rules. For the rolling window, they must wait until the oldest recent referral is more than 9 days old. Then close.
steps.if: the submission returns REJECTED or ERROR
steps.quote: A system error occurred; try again later or contact support.

rules.rule: Check referral eligibility (rolling window, tenure, referred-party restrictions) before giving any recommendation or referral terms.
rules.quote: Before giving any recommendations or information on referral terms, you must check that the user is eligible to submit referrals first

rules.rule: At most 2 referral bonuses in any rolling 9-day window, counted across all checking account types.
rules.quote: This limit applies across all checking account types; referrals from different accounts count toward the same 9-day cap.

rules.rule: After a rolling-window rejection, the customer must wait until the oldest qualifying referral is more than 9 days old.
rules.quote: If your referral was rejected due to the rolling window limit, you must wait until your oldest qualifying referral is more than 9 days old.

rules.rule: The referred party must have no Rho-Bank checking, savings or closed account in the past 12 months.
rules.quote: The referred person must be a new Rho-Bank customer with no existing checking, savings, or closed accounts within the past 12 months.

rules.rule: The referrer and the referred party cannot share a registered address.
rules.quote: The referrer and referred person cannot be registered at the same address.

rules.rule: The qualifying deposit must be new money, not a transfer from a Rho-Bank account.
rules.quote: The qualifying deposit must be new money and cannot be transferred from another Rho-Bank account.

rules.rule: A bonus may be clawed back if the referred account closes within 90 days. It cannot be stacked with other promotions.
rules.quote: If the referred account is closed within 90 days of opening, the referral bonus may be reversed (clawback provision).

rules.rule: No stacking with other new-account promotions.
rules.quote: The referral bonus cannot be combined with other new account promotions or sign-up bonuses.

rules.rule: Beige: referrer $500, 15 per calendar year, referred must deposit $100,000 within 120 days, tenure 120 days, handled via relationship manager.
rules.quote: They must deposit at least $100,000 within 120 days

rules.rule: Beige tenure is 120 days.
rules.quote: Referrer tenure requirement: 120 days since opening your first checking account with us.

rules.rule: Beige referrer bonus is $500; referrals go through the relationship manager.
rules.quote: Contact your dedicated relationship manager for referral materials

rules.rule: True Blue: referrer $350, annual limit 15, $50,000 within 120 days, tenure 90 days.
rules.quote: The referred business must deposit $50,000 within 120 days of opening their True Blue account.

rules.rule: True Blue tenure 90 days from oldest checking account; annual limit 15.
rules.quote: Referral bonuses are paid after qualification is confirmed and are subject to the annual limit of 15.

rules.rule: World Blue: referrer $300, 12 per calendar year.
rules.quote: 12 referral bonuses per calendar year

rules.rule: World Blue: $25,000 within 90 days; referrer tenure 90 days.
rules.quote: They must deposit at least $25,000 within 90 days of account opening

rules.rule: Lime Green: referrer $200, 12 per year, $15,000 within 90 days, tenure 90 days.
rules.quote: You must have maintained checking account status with Rho-Bank for a minimum of 90 days.

rules.rule: Hunter Green: referrer $175, up to 10 per year, $10,000 within 90 days, tenure 60 days.
rules.quote: A minimum relationship duration of 60 days as a checking account holder is required.

rules.rule: Cobalt Blue: referrer $150, 10 per calendar year.
rules.quote: Maximum referrals: 10 per calendar year

rules.rule: Cobalt Blue: $7,500 within 90 days; tenure 60 days from earliest checking account.
rules.quote: Your eligibility: To participate, your earliest-opened Rho-Bank checking account must have reached 60 days of age.

rules.rule: Sky Blue: referrer $150, 8 per year; for startups within 4 years of formation.
rules.quote: Confirm your company is within 4 years of formation.

rules.rule: Sky Blue: $10,000 within 90 days; tenure 45 days.
rules.quote: Your eligibility: Referrers must meet the 45-day tenure threshold based on their banking history with Rho-Bank.

rules.rule: Navy Blue: referrer $100, 10 per year, $5,000 within 90 days, tenure 60 days.
rules.quote: To qualify: The referred business must open a Navy Blue account and deposit at least $5,000 within 90 days of account opening.

draft.done_when: Either (a) the customer was told, from the records, why no referral can be made now (rolling window, tenure, referred-party restriction, annual caps or deposit size), and no recommendation was given; or (b) the customer was told which eligible account gives them the highest referrer bonus, with both bonus amounts and the conditions, and was told they can submit it with submit_referral.
